company.what_they_do: CARING, Inc. is a New Jersey-based nonprofit (501(c)3) that provides affordable housing, assisted living, day programs, and supportive services for seniors and adults with developmental or physical disabilities. Its core mission is preventing the premature institutionalization of these populations — helping them 'age in place' or live with dignity in community settings rather than long-term care facilities. Key programs include: Assisted Living Programs (ALP) offering nursing care, homemaker services, medication assistance, and transportation in publicly subsidized apartment buildings across Atlantic City, Millville, Wildwood, and Camden; CARINGHouse Projects — 55+ community-based group homes throughout NJ for adults with developmental disabilities; Memory Resource Center in Mays Landing (social daycare + caregiver respite for adults 60+ with cognitive/memory impairment); Transitional Adult Program (T.A.P.) in Pleasantville for adults with developmental disabilities (nursing, OT/PT, recreational activities); Social Day Centers in Atlantic City and Millville; CARING Senior Residential Services (HUD Section 202 and 811 subsidized housing); and Homemaker Services for Housing Authority residents. The organization was founded in 1977, growing from a volunteer group, and has been developing disability/senior housing since 1984.
